scope: small private teaching experiment; not an independently audited dataset
known_limitations: All selected pages have objects; no independently verified negatives.
Same reviewer conducted first and repeat overview; no independent QC.
Images were reviewed at overview scale, so subtle missed objects remain possible.
Source datasets declare CC BY 4.0 but rights of every underlying document are not established; keep raw data private.
Near-duplicate grouping uses reviewed candidates and dHash, which can miss related pages.
Validation has only three signature boxes; all results will be highly uncertain.
No model has been trained or evaluated; successful training and quality are not guaranteed.
